title: The Great Wall: about $6. Machu Picchu: about $40 | China Travel Expert
description:
Two of the New Seven Wonders of the World, two very different tickets. Machu Picchu runs a foreign adult about S/152 — roughly $40 USD in 2026. A ticketed section of China's Great Wall costs about 35–45 yuan, only around $5–6.

Badaling is 40 yuan in peak season and 35 yuan off-season (it's off-season now); Mutianyu is about 40–45 yuan year-round. Cable cars and shuttles are extra at both, but the wall itself is one of the world's great travel bargains. Same bucket-list status, a fraction of the price.

🧭 Expert Tip: Go in the off-season (November–March) for the 35-yuan Badaling rate and far thinner crowds — and pre-book, since the main sections now use real-name online booking.
